claims.claim: TopoVerus generates a structured source-level counterexample, repair rationale and repaired proof in one trajectory, trained with RL from Verus feedback and a proof-code safety gate
A counterexample is useful when conditioning on it helps produce a safe, verifier-passing proof
Verifier messages expose only a failed obligation, e.g. 'postcondition not satisfied', making repair brittle and token-inefficient
Prompt knowledge is costly to curate and does not generalize; verifier-outcome objectives give sparse indirect signals
Existing counterexample approaches (ExVerus = Yang et al. 2026b) need iterative refinement and hand-written validators
Binary-search insertion example with invariants I1-I5
Dependency-unaware vs dependency-aware diagnostics; repair high <= i -> high < i
Fig.2 bottom half is an intended/illustrative contrast
claims.locator: p.4 'shows the intended contrast'; topoverus.github.io worked example described as illustrative

claims.claim: Counterexample definition sigma |= A_t(sigma) and not C_t(sigma); tuple (sigma, tau, psi)
Reward R = S_safe[G_format(R_pass + lambda_dep R_dep) + lambda_format R_format]
R_pass binary; R_format in [0,0.4]; G_format prevents collapse to CoT repair
Released reward config uses verus_mode 'fraction', dependency_weight 1.0, format_partial 0.5, format_none 0.2, matcher_threshold 0.6
R_format computation (0.1 per block + 0.1 for three fields) and gate 1.0/0.5/0.2
Safety gate uses Lynette (Yang et al. 2025); unsafe modifications receive zero reward
Safe = Lynette confirms executable code and user specifications unchanged
Safety check runs before Verus in reward; unsafe returns zero score
trust_change rejects new assume/admit/axiom/external_body/external/verify(false)
Patched Lynette compare with -t --requires --ensures --spec --decreases --assumes; checker version topoverus-trusted-ghost-context-v4
Unit tests where Verus verifies but safety is unsafe (moved assume, changed trusted helper contract, unconditional assume)
Changing executable code { 1 } -> { 2 } or ensures false -> ensures true is unsafe
Definitions of inductive subset, dependency graph, SCC condensation
Invariant matching: exact substring then token-set Jaccard >= 0.6
R_dep = alpha*beta, coverage x edge satisfaction over inter-SCC edges, beta=1 if no edges
Graph precomputed offline; reward is O(|V|+|E|)
Level-wise BFS enumeration with antichain pruning, budget B=256
